import base64, textwrap, json
script = r'''
import sys
import math
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

counts_path, meta_path, annot_path = sys.argv[1:4]

annot = pd.read_csv(annot_path, dtype=str)
required_annot = {\"sample\", \"celltype\"}
missing = required_annot.difference(annot.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f\"Sample annotation missing columns: {sorted(missing)}\")
cd14_samples = annot.loc[annot[\"celltype\"].astype(str).str.upper() == \"CD14\", \"sample\"].astype(str).tolist()
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError(\"No CD14 samples found in sample annotation\")

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
counts.index = counts.index.astype(str)
missing_cd14 = [s for s in cd14_samples if s not in counts.columns]
if missing_cd14:
    raise ValueError(f\"CD14 samples missing from counts: {missing_cd14[:10]} (n={len(missing_cd14)})\")
cd14 = counts.loc[:, cd14_samples].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors=\"raise\")

meta = pd.read_csv(meta_path, index_col=0, dtype={\"gene_biotype\": str})
meta.index = meta.index.astype(str)
required_meta = {\"Length\", \"gene_biotype\"}
missing = required_meta.difference(meta.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f\"Gene metadata missing columns: {sorted(missing)}\")
meta[\"Length\"] = pd.to_numeric(meta[\"Length\"], errors=\"raise\")

# Preserve count rows as the analysis unit and attach metadata by gene row label.
df = pd.DataFrame(index=cd14.index)
df[\"total_cd14_counts\"] = cd14.sum(axis=1)
df[\"mean_cd14_expression\"] = cd14.mean(axis=1)
df = df.join(meta[[\"Length\", \"gene_biotype\"]], how=\"inner\")

selected = df[(df[\"gene_biotype\"] == \"protein_coding\") & (df[\"total_cd14_counts\"] >= 10)].copy()
selected = selected.dropna(subset=[\"Length\", \"mean_cd14_expression\"])
if len(selected) < 2:
    raise ValueError(f\"Fewer than two selected genes: {len(selected)}\")

r = selected[\"Length\"].corr(selected[\"mean_cd14_expression\"], method=\"pearson\")
if pd.isna(r):
    raise ValueError(\"Pearson correlation is NA\")

with open(\"answer.tsv\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as out:
    out.write(\"metric\\tvalue\\n\")
    out.write(f\"pearson_r\\t{r:.17g}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_cd14_samples\\t{len(cd14_samples)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_counts_genes\\t{len(cd14)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_joined_genes\\t{len(df)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_selected_genes\\t{len(selected)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"min_total_cd14_counts_selected\\t{selected['total_cd14_counts'].min():.17g}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"max_total_cd14_counts_selected\\t{selected['total_cd14_counts'].max():.17g}\\n\")
'''.strip() + '\\n'
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
meta_path <- args[[2]]
sample_path <- args[[3]]
answer_path <- args[[4]]
details_path <- args[[5]]

samples <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
cd14_samples <- samples$sample[samples$celltype == 'CD14']
if (length(cd14_samples) == 0) stop('No CD14 samples found')

meta <- read.csv(meta_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)

gene_col <- counts[[1]]
cd14_cols <- match(cd14_samples, names(counts))
if (any(is.na(cd14_cols))) {
  missing <- cd14_samples[is.na(cd14_cols)]
  stop(paste('Missing CD14 samples in count matrix:', paste(head(missing, 20), collapse=',')))
}

keep_meta_cols <- c('Geneid', 'Length', 'gene_biotype')
if (!all(keep_meta_cols %in% names(meta))) stop('Required metadata columns missing')
meta_small <- meta[, keep_meta_cols]
idx <- match(gene_col, meta_small$Geneid)
matched <- !is.na(idx)

length_vec <- as.numeric(meta_small$Length[idx])
biotype_vec <- meta_small$gene_biotype[idx]
expr_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, cd14_cols])
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- 'numeric'
totals <- rowSums(expr_mat)
means <- totals / length(cd14_cols)

protein <- matched & biotype_vec == 'protein_coding' & !is.na(length_vec)
expressed <- protein & totals >= 10
if (sum(expressed) < 3) stop('Fewer than three expressed protein-coding genes after filtering')

r <- cor(length_vec[expressed], means[expressed], method='pearson')
writeLines(format(r, digits=17, scientific=TRUE), answer_path)
details <- data.frame(metric=c('cd14_samples','count_matrix_cd14_columns','metadata_genes','matched_count_rows','protein_coding_matched_rows','expressed_protein_coding_rows_total_counts_ge_10','pearson_r'), value=c(length(cd14_samples), length(cd14_cols), nrow(meta_small), sum(matched), sum(protein), sum(expressed), format(r, digits=17, scientific=TRUE)))
write.table(details, details_path, sep='\t', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
RS

counts_path, meta_path, sample_path, answer_path, details_path = sys.argv[1:6]

with open(sample_path, newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    cd14_samples = [row['sample'] for row in reader if row.get('celltype') == 'CD14']
cd14_set = set(cd14_samples)
if not cd14_samples:
    raise SystemExit('No CD14 samples found')

meta = {}
with open(meta_path, newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        gene = row.get('Geneid') or row.get('')
        if not gene:
            continue
        try:
            length = float(row['Length'])
        except Exception:
            continue
        meta[gene] = {'length': length, 'gene_biotype': row.get('gene_biotype', '')}

lengths = []
means = []
protein_coding_seen = 0
matched_rows = 0
with open(counts_path, newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    cd14_indices = [i for i, sample in enumerate(header) if sample in cd14_set]
    cd14_order = [header[i] for i in cd14_indices]
    if len(cd14_indices) != len(cd14_samples):
        missing = sorted(cd14_set - set(cd14_order))
        raise SystemExit('Missing CD14 samples in count matrix: ' + ','.join(missing[:20]))
    for row in reader:
        if not row:
            continue
        gene = row[0]
        info = meta.get(gene)
        if info is None:
            continue
        matched_rows += 1
        if info['gene_biotype'] != 'protein_coding':
            continue
        protein_coding_seen += 1
        vals = []
        for idx in cd14_indices:
            if idx >= len(row) or row[idx] == '':
                value = 0.0
            else:
                value = float(row[idx])
            vals.append(value)
        total = sum(vals)
        if total >= 10.0:
            lengths.append(info['length'])
            means.append(total / len(vals))

if len(lengths) < 3:
    raise SystemExit('Fewer than three expressed protein-coding genes after filtering')

r, p = pearsonr(lengths, means)
with open(answer_path, 'w', newline='') as out:

    writer.writerow(['pearson_p_value', format(float(p), '.17g')])

import sys
import pandas as pd

counts_path, meta_path, sample_path, out_path = sys.argv[1:5]

samples = pd.read_csv(sample_path)
for col in ["sample", "celltype"]:
    if col not in samples.columns:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing sample annotation column: {col}")
cd14_samples = samples.loc[samples["celltype"].astype(str) == "CD14", "sample"].astype(str).tolist()
if not cd14_samples:
    raise SystemExit("no CD14 samples found")
if len(cd14_samples) != len(set(cd14_samples)):
    raise SystemExit("duplicate CD14 sample names in annotation")

count_header = pd.read_csv(counts_path, nrows=0).columns.tolist()
if not count_header:
    raise SystemExit("empty count matrix header")
gene_col = count_header[0]
missing = [s for s in cd14_samples if s not in count_header]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit("CD14 samples missing from count matrix: " + ",".join(missing[:10]))

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, usecols=[gene_col] + cd14_samples)
counts = counts.rename(columns={gene_col: "Geneid"})
if counts["Geneid"].duplicated().any():
    raise SystemExit("duplicate gene IDs in count matrix")
for s in cd14_samples:
    counts[s] = pd.to_numeric(counts[s], errors="raise")
counts["total_cd14"] = counts[cd14_samples].sum(axis=1)
counts["mean_expression"] = counts[cd14_samples].mean(axis=1)

meta = pd.read_csv(meta_path, usecols=["Geneid", "Length", "gene_biotype"])
if meta["Geneid"].duplicated().any():
    raise SystemExit("duplicate gene IDs in gene metadata")
meta["Length"] = pd.to_numeric(meta["Length"], errors="raise")

merged = counts.merge(meta, on="Geneid", how="inner", validate="one_to_one")
protein = merged[merged["gene_biotype"].astype(str) == "protein_coding"].copy()
expressed = protein[(protein["total_cd14"] >= 10) & protein["Length"].notna() & protein["mean_expression"].notna()].copy()
if len(expressed) < 2:
    raise SystemExit("fewer than two expressed protein-coding genes")

corr = expressed["Length"].corr(expressed["mean_expression"], method="pearson")
if pd.isna(corr):
    raise SystemExit("Pearson correlation is NaN")

rows = [
    ("pearson_correlation", format(float(corr), ".17g")),
    ("cd14_sample_count", str(len(cd14_samples))),
    ("count_gene_rows", str(len(counts))),
    ("metadata_gene_rows", str(len(meta))),
    ("matched_gene_rows", str(len(merged))),
    ("protein_coding_gene_rows", str(len(protein))),
    ("expressed_protein_coding_gene_rows", str(len(expressed))),
    ("expression_filter", "total_cd14_counts_ge_10"),
    ("expression_summary", "mean_across_cd14_samples"),
    ("correlation_method", "pearson_pandas_series_corr"),
]
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("metric\tvalue\n")
    for key, value in rows:
        out.write(f"{key}\t{value}\n")
PY

sample_path='inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv'
gene_path='inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv'

with open(sample_path, newline='') as f:
    cd14_samples=[row['sample'] for row in csv.DictReader(f) if row['celltype']=='CD14']
cd14_set=set(cd14_samples)

length_by_gene={}
biotype_by_gene={}
with open(gene_path, newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        gene=row['Geneid']
        length_by_gene[gene]=float(row['Length'])
        biotype_by_gene[gene]=row['gene_biotype']

n=0
sx=sy=sxx=syy=sxy=0.0
count_rows=0
missing_meta=0
protein_rows=0
protein_expressed=0
unmatched_cd14=[]
seen_genes=set()
with open(count_path, newline='') as f:
    r=csv.reader(f)
    header=next(r)
    col_index={name:i for i,name in enumerate(header)}
    unmatched_cd14=[s for s in cd14_samples if s not in col_index]
    idx=[col_index[s] for s in cd14_samples if s in col_index]
    for row in r:
        count_rows+=1
        gene=row[0]

        if biotype_by_gene[gene] "'!= '"'protein_coding':

# Recompute with a two-pass/centered formula to confirm the streamed result.
import csv, math
with open('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    cd14=[r['sample'] for r in csv.DictReader(f) if r['celltype']=='CD14']
meta={}
with open('inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r['gene_biotype']=='protein_coding':
            meta[r['Geneid']]=float(r['Length'])
vals=[]
with open('inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    reader=csv.reader(f)
    header=next(reader)
    pos={h:i for i,h in enumerate(header)}
    idx=[pos[s] for s in cd14]
    for row in reader:
        gene=row[0]
        if gene not in meta:
            continue
        total=math.fsum(float(row[i]) for i in idx)
        if total>=10:
            vals.append((meta[gene], total/len(idx)))
mx=math.fsum(x for x,y in vals)/len(vals)
my=math.fsum(y for x,y in vals)/len(vals)
num=math.fsum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in vals)
dx=math.fsum((x-mx)*(x-mx) for x,y in vals)
dy=math.fsum((y-my)*(y-my) for x,y in vals)
r=num/math.sqrt(dx*dy)
print(len(vals), format(r,'.17g'))

representation.name: CD14 gene length vs mean expression Pearson
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.py <<'PY'
import csv
import math
import sys
import scipy
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

counts_path, meta_path, annotation_path, output_path = sys.argv[1:5]

with open(annotation_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
    required = {"sample", "celltype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Sample annotation is missing required columns")
    annotation_rows = list(reader)

sample_ids = [row["sample"] for row in annotation_rows]
if len(sample_ids) != len(set(sample_ids)):
    raise ValueError("Sample annotation contains duplicate sample identifiers")
cd14_samples = [row["sample"] for row in annotation_rows if row["celltype"] == "CD14"]
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError("No samples have celltype exactly CD14")
cd14_set = set(cd14_samples)

meta = {}
with open(meta_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
    required = {"Geneid", "Length", "gene_biotype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Gene metadata is missing required columns")
    for row in reader:
        gene = row["Geneid"]
        if gene in meta:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate Geneid in metadata: " + gene)
        meta[gene] = (row["Length"], row["gene_biotype"])

lengths = []
means = []
seen_genes = set()
with open(counts_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    header = next(reader)
    count_samples = header[1:]
    if len(count_samples) != len(set(count_samples)):
        raise ValueError("Counts matrix contains duplicate sample columns")
    if set(count_samples) != set(sample_ids):
        missing_counts = sorted(set(sample_ids) - set(count_samples))
        missing_annotation = sorted(set(count_samples) - set(sample_ids))
        raise ValueError("Counts/annotation sample mismatch: %d missing in counts, %d missing in annotation" % (len(missing_counts), len(missing_annotation)))
    cd14_indices = [i + 1 for i, sample in enumerate(count_samples) if sample in cd14_set]
    if len(cd14_indices) != len(cd14_samples):
        raise ValueError("Not all CD14 samples were found in counts matrix")
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError("Counts row %d has %d fields; expected %d" % (row_number, len(row), len(header)))
        gene = row[0]
        if gene in seen_genes:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate gene in counts matrix: " + gene)
        seen_genes.add(gene)
        if gene not in meta:
            raise ValueError("Counts gene absent from metadata: " + gene)
        length_text, biotype = meta[gene]
        if biotype != "protein_coding":
            continue
        values = [float(row[i]) for i in cd14_indices]
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):
            raise ValueError("Non-finite CD14 count for gene: " + gene)
        total = sum(values)
        if total < 10.0:
            continue
        length = float(length_text)
        if not math.isfinite(length):
            raise ValueError("Non-finite gene length for gene: " + gene)
        lengths.append(length)
        means.append(total / float(len(cd14_indices)))

if seen_genes != set(meta):
    raise ValueError("Counts and metadata gene sets differ")
if len(lengths) < 2:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than two genes passed the requested filters")

r_value, p_value = pearsonr(lengths, means)
with open(output_path, "w") as handle:
    handle.write("pearson_r\tp_value\tn_genes\tn_cd14_samples\ttotal_count_threshold\tbiotype\tsample_scope\tmean_definition\tscipy_version\n")
    handle.write("%.17g\t%.17g\t%d\t%d\t10\tprotein_coding\tcelltype=CD14\tarithmetic_mean_across_CD14_samples\t%s\n" % (r_value, p_value, len(lengths), len(cd14_indices), scipy.__version__))
PY
python job.py "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.meta.path)" "$(inputs.annotation.path)" result.tsv

import csv
import math
import sys
import scipy
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

counts_path, meta_path, annotation_path, output_path = sys.argv[1:5]

with open(annotation_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
    required = {"sample", "celltype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Sample annotation is missing required columns")
    annotation_rows = list(reader)

sample_ids = [row["sample"] for row in annotation_rows]
if len(sample_ids) != len(set(sample_ids)):
    raise ValueError("Sample annotation contains duplicate sample identifiers")
cd14_samples = [row["sample"] for row in annotation_rows if row["celltype"] == "CD14"]
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError("No samples have celltype exactly CD14")
cd14_set = set(cd14_samples)

meta = {}
with open(meta_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
    required = {"Geneid", "Length", "gene_biotype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Gene metadata is missing required columns")
    for row in reader:
        gene = row["Geneid"]
        if gene in meta:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate Geneid in metadata: " + gene)
        meta[gene] = (row["Length"], row["gene_biotype"])

lengths = []
means = []
seen_genes = set()
with open(counts_path, "r") as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    header = next(reader)
    count_samples = header[1:]
    if len(count_samples) != len(set(count_samples)):
        raise ValueError("Counts matrix contains duplicate sample columns")
    if set(count_samples) != set(sample_ids):
        missing_counts = sorted(set(sample_ids) - set(count_samples))
        missing_annotation = sorted(set(count_samples) - set(sample_ids))
        raise ValueError("Counts/annotation sample mismatch: %d missing in counts, %d missing in annotation" % (len(missing_counts), len(missing_annotation)))
    cd14_indices = [i + 1 for i, sample in enumerate(count_samples) if sample in cd14_set]
    if len(cd14_indices) != len(cd14_samples):
        raise ValueError("Not all CD14 samples were found in counts matrix")
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError("Counts row %d has %d fields; expected %d" % (row_number, len(row), len(header)))
        gene = row[0]
        if gene in seen_genes:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate gene in counts matrix: " + gene)
        seen_genes.add(gene)
        if gene not in meta:
            raise ValueError("Counts gene absent from metadata: " + gene)
        length_text, biotype = meta[gene]
        if biotype != "protein_coding":
            continue
        values = [float(row[i]) for i in cd14_indices]
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):
            raise ValueError("Non-finite CD14 count for gene: " + gene)
        total = sum(values)
        if total < 10.0:
            continue
        length = float(length_text)
        if not math.isfinite(length):
            raise ValueError("Non-finite gene length for gene: " + gene)
        lengths.append(length)
        means.append(total / float(len(cd14_indices)))

if seen_genes != set(meta):
    raise ValueError("Counts and metadata gene sets differ")
if len(lengths) < 2:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than two genes passed the requested filters")

r_value, p_value = pearsonr(lengths, means)
with open(output_path, "w") as handle:
    handle.write("pearson_r\tp_value\tn_genes\tn_cd14_samples\ttotal_count_threshold\tbiotype\tsample_scope\tmean_definition\tscipy_version\n")
    handle.write("%.17g\t%.17g\t%d\t%d\t10\tprotein_coding\tcelltype=CD14\tarithmetic_mean_across_CD14_samples\t%s\n" % (r_value, p_value, len(lengths), len(cd14_indices), scipy.__version__))
PY

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('inputs')

    rd=csv.DictReader(f); key=rd.fieldnames[0]

def corr(xs,ys):
    n=len(xs); mx=math.fsum(xs)/n; my=math.fsum(ys)/n
    sxx=math.fsum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
    syy=math.fsum((y-my)**2 for y in ys)
    sxy=math.fsum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
    return sxy/math.sqrt(sxx*syy)
with open(p/'BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:

    h=next(rd)
    pos={v:i for i,v in enumerate(h)}
    assert h[0]==''
    assert set(h[1:])=={r['sample'] for r in samples}
    cdidx=[pos[x] for x in cd14_names]
    for lineno,row in enumerate(rd,2):
        if len(row)"'!=len(h): bad_width+=1; continue
        gene=row[0]
        vals=[float(row[i]) for i in cdidx]
        if any(not math.isfinite(v) for v in vals): nonfinite+=1
        negative += sum(v<0 for v in vals)
        noninteger += sum(v!=round(v) for v in vals)
        ctot=math.fsum(vals)
        atot=math.fsum(float(v) for v in row[1:])
        length,bt=meta[gene]
        records.append((gene,length,bt,ctot,atot))
assert len(records)==len(meta)==59453

def corr(xs,ys):
    n=len(xs)
    mx=math.fsum(xs)/n; my=math.fsum(ys)/n
    dx=[v-mx for v in xs]; dy=[v-my for v in ys]
    return math.fsum(a*b for a,b in zip(dx,dy))/math.sqrt(math.fsum(a*a for a in dx)*math.fsum(b*b for b in dy))

    x=[r[1] for r in z]
    # mean expression = CD14 total / n CD14; correlation unchanged by constant scale

result('exact protein; all-sample total>=10',lambda r:r[2]=='protein_coding' and r[4]>=10)

representation.name: CD14 protein-coding gene length vs mean expression Pearson correlation
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.counts_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.gene_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" <<'PY'
import csv
import sys
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

counts_path, gene_metadata_path, sample_metadata_path = sys.argv[1:4]

selected_samples = []
with open(sample_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
        if row.get("celltype") == "CD14":
            selected_samples.append(row.get("sample"))
if not selected_samples or any(x is None or x == "" for x in selected_samples):
    raise ValueError("No valid CD14 sample names were found")
if len(selected_samples) != len(set(selected_samples)):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate CD14 sample names in sample metadata")

gene_info = {}
with open(gene_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row.get("")
        if not gene_id:
            gene_id = row.get("Geneid")
        if not gene_id:
            raise ValueError("Gene metadata row has no gene identifier")
        if gene_id in gene_info:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate gene identifier in gene metadata: " + gene_id)
        if row.get("gene_biotype") == "protein_coding":
            gene_info[gene_id] = int(row["Length"])

lengths = []
means = []
rows_seen = 0
rows_retained = 0
with open(counts_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.reader(fh)
    header = next(reader)
    if len(header) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Counts matrix has no sample columns")
    positions = []
    for sample in selected_samples:
        try:
            positions.append(header.index(sample))
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError("CD14 sample absent from counts matrix: " + sample)
    if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate sample columns selected from counts matrix")
    for row in reader:
        rows_seen += 1
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError("Counts row has a different number of columns at row {}".format(rows_seen + 1))
        gene_id = row[0]
        info = gene_info.get(gene_id)
        if info is None:
            continue
        values = [float(row[pos]) for pos in positions]
        total = sum(values)
        if total >= 10:
            rows_retained += 1
            lengths.append(float(info))
            means.append(total / float(len(values)))

if len(lengths) < 3:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")
r_value = pearsonr(lengths, means)[0]

with open("correlation.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("metric\tvalue\tcelltype\tselected_samples\tgene_biotype\ttotal_count_threshold\tgenes_retained\tcounts_rows_seen\n")
    out.write("pearson_r\t{:.17g}\tCD14\t{}\tprotein_coding\t10\t{}\t{}\n".format(
        float(r_value), len(selected_samples), rows_retained, rows_seen))
PY

representation.name: CD14 protein-coding gene length vs mean expression Pearson correlation (R)
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla -e 'stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(stats::cor(c(1, 2), c(1, 2)), 1)))'
Rscript --vanilla - "$(inputs.counts_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.gene_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("Expected counts, gene metadata, and sample metadata paths")
counts_path <- args[[1]]
gene_metadata_path <- args[[2]]
sample_metadata_path <- args[[3]]

sample_metadata <- read.csv(sample_metadata_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cd14_samples <- sample_metadata$sample[sample_metadata$celltype == "CD14"]
if (length(cd14_samples) == 0L || any(is.na(cd14_samples)) || any(cd14_samples == "")) stop("No valid CD14 sample names")
if (anyDuplicated(cd14_samples)) stop("Duplicate CD14 sample names")

gene_metadata <- read.csv(gene_metadata_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_metadata_ids <- gene_metadata[[1L]]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_metadata_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers in gene metadata")

counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
count_ids <- counts[[1L]]
sample_names <- names(counts)[-1L]
positions <- match(cd14_samples, sample_names)
if (anyNA(positions)) stop("A CD14 sample is absent from the counts matrix")
if (anyDuplicated(positions)) stop("Duplicate CD14 columns selected")

cd14_counts <- counts[, positions + 1L, drop = FALSE]
if (!all(vapply(cd14_counts, is.numeric, logical(1)))) stop("Selected count columns are not numeric")
total_counts <- rowSums(as.matrix(cd14_counts))
mean_expression <- total_counts / length(positions)

metadata_position <- match(count_ids, gene_metadata_ids)
if (anyNA(metadata_position)) stop("A count-matrix gene is absent from gene metadata")
biotype <- gene_metadata$gene_biotype[metadata_position]
gene_length <- as.numeric(gene_metadata$Length[metadata_position])
keep <- biotype == "protein_coding" & total_counts >= 10 & !is.na(gene_length) & !is.na(mean_expression)
if (sum(keep) < 3L) stop("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")

r_value <- stats::cor(gene_length[keep], mean_expression[keep], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")

result <- data.frame(
  metric = "pearson_r",
  value = sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(r_value)),
  celltype = "CD14",
  selected_samples = length(positions),
  gene_biotype = "protein_coding",
  total_count_threshold = 10,
  genes_retained = sum(keep),
  counts_rows_seen = nrow(counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = "correlation.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RS

import csv
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

counts_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
gene_meta_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
sample_meta_path = Path(sys.argv[3])

with sample_meta_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    sample_reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    required = {"sample", "celltype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(sample_reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Sample metadata lacks sample/celltype columns")
    cd14_samples = [
        row["sample"]
        for row in sample_reader
        if row.get("celltype") == "CD14"
    ]
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError("No CD14 samples found")

gene_meta = {}
with gene_meta_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    gene_reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    required = {"Geneid", "Length", "gene_biotype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(gene_reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Gene metadata lacks Geneid/Length/gene_biotype columns")
    for row in gene_reader:
        gene_id = row["Geneid"]
        if not gene_id:
            raise ValueError("Blank Geneid in gene metadata")
        if gene_id in gene_meta:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate Geneid in gene metadata: " + gene_id)
        gene_meta[gene_id] = (
            int(float(row["Length"])),
            row["gene_biotype"],
        )

kept = 0
seen_counts = set()
with counts_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    count_reader = csv.reader(fh)
    header = next(count_reader)
    if len(header) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Count matrix has no sample columns")
    count_samples = header[1:]
    if len(set(count_samples)) != len(count_samples):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate sample names in count matrix header")
    sample_to_col = {sample: idx + 1 for idx, sample in enumerate(count_samples)}
    missing = [sample for sample in cd14_samples if sample not in sample_to_col]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("CD14 samples missing from count matrix: " + ",".join(missing[:5]))
    selected_cols = [sample_to_col[sample] for sample in cd14_samples]

    with Path("gene_lengths.tsv").open("w") as length_out, Path("gene_means.tsv").open("w") as mean_out:
        length_out.write("gene_id\tgene_length\n")
        mean_out.write("gene_id\tmean_expression\n")
        for row in count_reader:
            if not row:
                continue
            gene_id = row[0]
            if gene_id in seen_counts:
                raise ValueError("Duplicate gene in count matrix: " + gene_id)
            seen_counts.add(gene_id)
            meta = gene_meta.get(gene_id)
            if meta is None:
                raise ValueError("Count gene missing from gene metadata: " + gene_id)
            length, biotype = meta
            if biotype != "protein_coding":
                continue
            if len(row) != len(header):
                raise ValueError("Count row has wrong number of columns for " + gene_id)
            values = np.fromiter(
                (row[col] for col in selected_cols),
                dtype=np.float64,
                count=len(selected_cols),
            )
            total_counts = np.sum(values, dtype=np.float64)
            if total_counts < 10.0:
                continue
            mean_expression = np.mean(values, dtype=np.float64)
            length_out.write(gene_id + "\t" + str(length) + "\n")
            mean_out.write(
                gene_id + "\t" + format(float(mean_expression), ".17g") + "\n"
            )
            kept += 1

if kept < 3:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than three genes passed the filter")
print("CD14 samples:", len(cd14_samples), file=sys.stderr)
print("Protein-coding genes passing total-count filter:", kept, file=sys.stderr)

PY

import csv
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

counts_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
gene_meta_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
sample_meta_path = Path(sys.argv[3])

with sample_meta_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    sample_reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    required = {"sample", "celltype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(sample_reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Sample metadata lacks sample/celltype columns")
    cd14_samples = [
        row["sample"]
        for row in sample_reader
        if row.get("celltype") == "CD14"
    ]
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError("No CD14 samples found")

gene_meta = {}
with gene_meta_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    gene_reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    required = {"Geneid", "Length", "gene_biotype"}
    if not required.issubset(set(gene_reader.fieldnames or [])):
        raise ValueError("Gene metadata lacks Geneid/Length/gene_biotype columns")
    for row in gene_reader:
        gene_id = row["Geneid"]
        if not gene_id:
            raise ValueError("Blank Geneid in gene metadata")
        if gene_id in gene_meta:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate Geneid in gene metadata: " + gene_id)
        gene_meta[gene_id] = (
            int(float(row["Length"])),
            row["gene_biotype"],
        )

kept = 0
seen_counts = set()
with counts_path.open("r", newline="") as fh:
    count_reader = csv.reader(fh)
    header = next(count_reader)
    if len(header) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Count matrix has no sample columns")
    count_samples = header[1:]
    if len(set(count_samples)) != len(count_samples):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate sample names in count matrix header")
    sample_to_col = {sample: idx + 1 for idx, sample in enumerate(count_samples)}
    missing = [sample for sample in cd14_samples if sample not in sample_to_col]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("CD14 samples missing from count matrix: " + ",".join(missing[:5]))
    selected_cols = [sample_to_col[sample] for sample in cd14_samples]

    with Path("gene_lengths.tsv").open("w") as length_out, Path("gene_means.tsv").open("w") as mean_out:
        length_out.write("gene_id\tgene_length\n")
        mean_out.write("gene_id\tmean_expression\n")
        for row in count_reader:
            if not row:
                continue
            gene_id = row[0]
            if gene_id in seen_counts:
                raise ValueError("Duplicate gene in count matrix: " + gene_id)
            seen_counts.add(gene_id)
            meta = gene_meta.get(gene_id)
            if meta is None:
                raise ValueError("Count gene missing from gene metadata: " + gene_id)
            length, biotype = meta
            if biotype != "protein_coding":
                continue
            if len(row) != len(header):
                raise ValueError("Count row has wrong number of columns for " + gene_id)
            values = np.fromiter(
                (row[col] for col in selected_cols),
                dtype=np.float64,
                count=len(selected_cols),
            )
            total_counts = np.sum(values, dtype=np.float64)
            if total_counts < 10.0:
                continue
            mean_expression = np.mean(values, dtype=np.float64)
            length_out.write(gene_id + "\t" + str(length) + "\n")
            mean_out.write(
                gene_id + "\t" + format(float(mean_expression), ".17g") + "\n"
            )
            kept += 1

if kept < 3:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than three genes passed the filter")
print("CD14 samples:", len(cd14_samples), file=sys.stderr)
print("Protein-coding genes passing total-count filter:", kept, file=sys.stderr)

    def copy_history(self, history_id: str, name: str | None = None, all_datasets: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Create a new history by copying an existing one.

        :type history_id: str
        :param history_id: ID of the history to copy.

        :type name: str
        :param name: Optional name for new history

        :type all_datasets: bool
        :param all_datasets: Whether to copy also deleted datasets and dataset collections.

        :rtype: dict
        :return: Dictionary containing information about the newly created history
        """
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"source": "history"}
        if name is not None:
            payload["name"] = name
        payload["history_id"] = history_id
        if all_datasets:
            payload["all_datasets"] = all_datasets

        return self._post(payload)

import base64, json
script = r'''import csv
import math
import sys

counts_path, gene_path, sample_path = sys.argv[1:4]

cd14 = set()
with open(sample_path, newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row['celltype'].strip() == 'CD14':
            cd14.add(row['sample'].strip())

length_by_gene = {}
with open(gene_path, newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row['gene_biotype'].strip() == 'protein_coding':
            gid = row['Geneid'].strip()
            length_by_gene[gid] = float(row['Length'])

xs = []
ys = []
with open(counts_path, newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    idx = [j for j, name in enumerate(header) if name.strip() in cd14]
    if not idx:
        raise RuntimeError('No CD14 sample columns found in counts matrix')
    n = len(idx)
    for row in reader:
        gid = row[0].strip()
        length = length_by_gene.get(gid)
        if length is None:
            continue
        total = 0.0
        for j in idx:
            total += float(row[j])
        if total >= 10.0:
            xs.append(length)
            ys.append(total / n)

if len(xs) < 2:
    raise RuntimeError('Fewer than two valid protein-coding genes passed filters')

mx = sum(xs) / len(xs)
my = sum(ys) / len(ys)
sxx = sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)
syy = sum((y - my) ** 2 for y in ys)
sxy = sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
if sxx == 0.0 or syy == 0.0:
    raise RuntimeError('Zero variance; Pearson correlation is undefined')

r = sxy / math.sqrt(sxx * syy)
with open('result.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write(f'{r:.10f}\\n')
'''

            ys.append(total / n)

if len(xs) < 2:

mx = sum(xs) / len(xs)
my = sum(ys) / len(ys)
sxx = sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)
syy = sum((y - my) ** 2 for y in ys)
sxy = sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
if sxx == 0.0 or syy == 0.0:

print('missing meta', len(set(counts.index)-set(meta.index)), 'missing counts', len(set(meta.index)-set(counts.index)))
# produce dataframe in counts order with length

biotype = meta['gene_biotype'].reindex(counts.index)

import csv, math
# read sample annotations with csv
cd14=set()
with open('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row['celltype']=='CD14':
            cd14.add(row['sample'])
print('n cd14', len(cd14))
# read meta
length={}; biotype={}
with open('inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        length[row['Geneid']]=float(row['Length'])
        biotype[row['Geneid']]=row['gene_biotype']
# stream count matrix, compute total and mean for protein_coding only
with open('inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', newline='') as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    headers=r.fieldnames
    cols=[i for i,h in enumerate(headers) if h in cd14]
    print('cd14 cols found', len(cols))
    totals=[]; means=[]; lens=[]; genes=[]
    for row in r:
        gene=row[headers[0]]
        if biotype.get(gene)=='protein_coding':
            s=0.0
            for i in cols:
                val=row[headers[i]]
                s += float(val)
            if s>=10:
                n=len(cols)
                totals.append(s)
                means.append(s/n)
                lens.append(length[gene])
                genes.append(gene)
print('eligible', len(totals))
# Pearson pure
n=len(lens)
mx=sum(lens)/n; my=sum(means)/n
sxy=sum((lens[i]-mx)*(means[i]-my) for i in range(n))
sxx=sum((lens[i]-mx)**2 for i in range(n))
syy=sum((means[i]-my)**2 for i in range(n))
r=sxy/math.sqrt(sxx*syy)
print('r pure', repr(r))
print('meanx', mx, 'meany', my)

parameters.args:
I need to create a UDT that:
1. Takes expression matrix (genes×samples CSV), sample annotations CSV, and gene metadata CSV as inputs
2. Filters sample_annot for celltype=="CD14" to get CD14 sample names
3. For each gene in the expression matrix, computes sum and mean across CD14 sample columns
4. Filters genes where sum ≥ 10 (total counts threshold)
5. Joins with gene metadata to get Length and gene_biotype
6. Filters for protein_coding genes
7. Computes Pearson correlation between gene Length and mean expression
8. Outputs the correlation coefficient and the intermediate filtered data

Use a public container with Python and scipy for the correlation calculation.

{
  "id": "cd14_correlation",
  "name": "CD14 Gene Length vs Expression Correlation",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Compute Pearson correlation between gene length and mean expression for protein-coding genes in CD14 cells",
  "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/python:3.13.7",
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "expr_matrix",
      "type": "data",
      "format": ["csv", "tabular", "txt"],
      "label": "Expression matrix (genes x samples CSV)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sample_annot",
      "type": "data",
      "format": ["csv", "tabular"],
      "label": "Sample annotations CSV"
    },
    {
      "name": "gene_meta",
      "type": "data",
      "format": ["csv", "tabular"],
      "label": "Gene metadata CSV"
    }
  ],
  "outputs": [
    {
      "name": "correlation_result",
      "type": "data",
      "format": "txt",
      "label": "Pearson correlation coefficient",
      "from_work_dir": "correlation_result.txt"
    },
    {
      "name": "gene_data",
      "type": "data",
      "format": "tabular",
      "label": "Filtered gene data (gene, mean_expr, sum_counts, length, biotype)",
      "from_work_dir": "gene_data.tsv"
    }
  ],
  "shell_command": "python3 << 'PYEOF'
import csv
import math
import sys

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read sample annotations to find CD14 samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cd14_samples = set()
with open('$(inputs.sample_annot.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row.get('celltype', '').strip() == 'CD14':
            sample_name = row.get('sample', '').strip()
            if sample_name:
                cd14_samples.add(sample_name)

if not cd14_samples:
    print('ERROR: No CD14 samples found in sample annotations', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print(f'Found {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples', file=sys.stderr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read gene metadata: gene_id -> (length, biotype)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_info = {}
with open('$(inputs.gene_meta.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row.get('Geneid', '').strip()
        length_str = row.get('Length', '0').strip()
        biotype = row.get('gene_biotype', '').strip()
        if gene_id:
            try:
                length = float(length_str)
            except ValueError:
                length = 0.0
            gene_info[gene_id] = (length, biotype)

print(f'Loaded metadata for {len(gene_info)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Read expression matrix and compute per-gene CD14 stats
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cd14_col_indices = []
gene_stats = []  # list of (gene_name, sum_counts, mean_expr, n_cd14_samples)

with open('$(inputs.expr_matrix.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    
    # Map sample name -> column index
    for i, col_name in enumerate(header):
        if col_name.strip() in cd14_samples:
            cd14_col_indices.append(i)
    
    print(f'Found {len(cd14_col_indices)} CD14 columns in expression matrix', file=sys.stderr)
    
    n_cd14 = len(cd14_col_indices)
    if n_cd14 == 0:
        print('ERROR: No CD14 columns found in expression matrix', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    for row in reader:
        if not row or len(row) < 2:
            continue
        gene_name = row[0].strip()
        if not gene_name:
            continue
        
        # Extract CD14 column values
        total = 0.0
        valid_count = 0
        for ci in cd14_col_indices:
            if ci < len(row):
                val_str = row[ci].strip()
                if val_str:
                    try:
                        total += float(val_str)
                        valid_count += 1
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
        
        if valid_count > 0:
            mean_expr = total / valid_count
        else:
            mean_expr = 0.0
        
        gene_stats.append((gene_name, total, mean_expr, valid_count))

print(f'Computed stats for {len(gene_stats)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter: total counts >= 10, protein_coding, has length
# ------------------------------------------------------------
filtered = []
for gene_name, total, mean_expr, n_samples in gene_stats:
    if total < 10:
        continue
    info = gene_info.get(gene_name)
    if info is None:
        continue
    length, biotype = info
    if biotype != 'protein_coding':
        continue
    if length <= 0:
        continue
    filtered.append((gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype))

print(f'After filtering (sum>=10, protein_coding): {len(filtered)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Compute Pearson correlation: Length vs mean_expression
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if len(filtered) < 3:
    print('ERROR: Too few genes for correlation', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

lengths = [f[3] for f in filtered]
means = [f[1] for f in filtered]

n = len(lengths)
mean_len = sum(lengths) / n
mean_expr_all = sum(means) / n

cov = sum((lengths[i] - mean_len) * (means[i] - mean_expr_all) for i in range(n))
std_len = math.sqrt(sum((l - mean_len)**2 for l in lengths))
std_expr = math.sqrt(sum((m - mean_expr_all)**2 for m in means))

if std_len == 0 or std_expr == 0:
    pearson_r = 0.0
else:
    pearson_r = cov / (std_len * std_expr)

print(f'Pearson r = {pearson_r:.10f}', file=sys.stderr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Write outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
with open('correlation_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'{pearson_r:.10f}\n')

with open('gene_data.tsv', 'w') as f:
    f.write('gene\tmean_expression\ttotal_counts\tlength\tbiotype\n')
    for gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype in filtered:
        f.write(f'{gene_name}\t{mean_expr:.6f}\t{total:.6f}\t{length:.0f}\t{biotype}\n')

print('Done.', file=sys.stderr)
PYEOF"
}

parameters.content:
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: cd14-correlation-v1
name: CD14 Gene Length vs Expression Correlation
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/python:3.13.7

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  python3 << 'PYEOF'
  import csv
  import math
  import sys

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Read sample annotations to find CD14 samples
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cd14_samples = set()
  with open('$(inputs.sample_annot.path)', 'r') as f:
      reader = csv.DictReader(f)
      for row in reader:
          if row.get('celltype', '').strip() == 'CD14':
              sample_name = row.get('sample', '').strip()
              if sample_name:
                  cd14_samples.add(sample_name)

  if not cd14_samples:
      print('ERROR: No CD14 samples found', file=sys.stderr)
      sys.exit(1)

  print(f'Found {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples', file=sys.stderr)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Read gene metadata: gene_id -> (length, biotype)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  gene_info = {}
  with open('$(inputs.gene_meta.path)', 'r') as f:
      reader = csv.DictReader(f)
      for row in reader:
          gene_id = row.get('Geneid', '').strip()
          length_str = row.get('Length', '0').strip()
          biotype = row.get('gene_biotype', '').strip()
          if gene_id:
              try:
                  length = float(length_str)
              except ValueError:
                  length = 0.0
              gene_info[gene_id] = (length, biotype)

  print(f'Loaded metadata for {len(gene_info)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Read expression matrix and compute per-gene CD14 stats
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cd14_col_indices = []
  gene_stats = []

  with open('$(inputs.expr_matrix.path)', 'r') as f:
      reader = csv.reader(f)
      header = next(reader)

      for i, col_name in enumerate(header):
          if col_name.strip() in cd14_samples:
              cd14_col_indices.append(i)

      print(f'Found {len(cd14_col_indices)} CD14 columns in expression matrix',
            file=sys.stderr)

      n_cd14 = len(cd14_col_indices)
      if n_cd14 == 0:
          print('ERROR: No CD14 columns found', file=sys.stderr)
          sys.exit(1)

      for row in reader:
          if not row or len(row) < 2:
              continue
          gene_name = row[0].strip()
          if not gene_name:
              continue

          total = 0.0
          valid_count = 0
          for ci in cd14_col_indices:
              if ci < len(row):
                  val_str = row[ci].strip()
                  if val_str:
                      try:
                          total += float(val_str)
                          valid_count += 1
                      except ValueError:
                          pass

          if valid_count > 0:
              mean_expr = total / valid_count
          else:
              mean_expr = 0.0

          gene_stats.append((gene_name, total, mean_expr, valid_count))

  print(f'Computed stats for {len(gene_stats)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Filter: total counts >= 10, protein_coding, has length
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  filtered = []
  for gene_name, total, mean_expr, n_samples in gene_stats:
      if total < 10:
          continue
      info = gene_info.get(gene_name)
      if info is None:
          continue
      length, biotype = info
      if biotype != 'protein_coding':
          continue
      if length <= 0:
          continue
      filtered.append((gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype))

  print(f'After filtering (sum>=10, protein_coding): {len(filtered)} genes',
        file=sys.stderr)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Compute Pearson correlation: Length vs mean_expression
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  if len(filtered) < 3:
      print('ERROR: Too few genes for correlation', file=sys.stderr)
      sys.exit(1)

  lengths = [f[3] for f in filtered]
  means = [f[1] for f in filtered]

  n = len(lengths)
  mean_len = sum(lengths) / n
  mean_expr_all = sum(means) / n

  cov = sum((lengths[i] - mean_len) * (means[i] - mean_expr_all)
            for i in range(n))
  std_len = math.sqrt(sum((l - mean_len)**2 for l in lengths))
  std_expr = math.sqrt(sum((m - mean_expr_all)**2 for m in means))

  if std_len == 0 or std_expr == 0:
      pearson_r = 0.0
  else:
      pearson_r = cov / (std_len * std_expr)

  print(f'Pearson r = {pearson_r:.10f}', file=sys.stderr)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Write outputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  with open('correlation_result.txt', 'w') as f:
      f.write(f'{pearson_r:.10f}\n')

  with open('gene_data.tsv', 'w') as f:
      f.write('gene\tmean_expression\ttotal_counts\tlength\tbiotype\n')
      for gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype in filtered:
          f.write(f'{gene_name}\t{mean_expr:.6f}\t{total:.6f}'
                  f'\t{length:.0f}\t{biotype}\n')

  print('Done.', file=sys.stderr)
  PYEOF

  - name: expr_matrix
    type: data
    format: [csv, txt]
    label: Expression matrix (genes x samples CSV)

  - name: sample_annot

  - name: gene_meta
    type: data
    format: [csv]
    label: Gene metadata CSV

outputs:

    type: data
    format: txt
    label: Pearson correlation coefficient
    from_work_dir: correlation_result.txt

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import csv
import math
import sys

cd14_samples = set()
with open('$(inputs.sample_annot.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row.get('celltype', '').strip() == 'CD14':
            sample_name = row.get('sample', '').strip()
            if sample_name:
                cd14_samples.add(sample_name)

if not cd14_samples:
    print('ERROR: No CD14 samples found', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print(f'Found {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples', file=sys.stderr)

gene_info = {}
with open('$(inputs.gene_meta.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row.get('Geneid', '').strip()
        length_str = row.get('Length', '0').strip()
        biotype = row.get('gene_biotype', '').strip()
        if gene_id:
            try:
                length = float(length_str)
            except ValueError:
                length = 0.0
            gene_info[gene_id] = (length, biotype)

print(f'Loaded metadata for {len(gene_info)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

cd14_col_indices = []
gene_stats = []

with open('$(inputs.expr_matrix.path)', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)

    for i, col_name in enumerate(header):
        if col_name.strip() in cd14_samples:
            cd14_col_indices.append(i)

    print(f'Found {len(cd14_col_indices)} CD14 columns in expression matrix', file=sys.stderr)

    n_cd14 = len(cd14_col_indices)
    if n_cd14 == 0:
        print('ERROR: No CD14 columns found', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    for row in reader:
        if not row or len(row) < 2:
            continue
        gene_name = row[0].strip()
        if not gene_name:
            continue

        total = 0.0
        valid_count = 0
        for ci in cd14_col_indices:
            if ci < len(row):
                val_str = row[ci].strip()
                if val_str:
                    try:
                        total += float(val_str)
                        valid_count += 1
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

        if valid_count > 0:
            mean_expr = total / valid_count
        else:
            mean_expr = 0.0

        gene_stats.append((gene_name, total, mean_expr, valid_count))

print(f'Computed stats for {len(gene_stats)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

filtered = []
for gene_name, total, mean_expr, n_samples in gene_stats:
    if total < 10:
        continue
    info = gene_info.get(gene_name)
    if info is None:
        continue
    length, biotype = info
    if biotype != 'protein_coding':
        continue
    if length <= 0:
        continue
    filtered.append((gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype))

print(f'After filtering (sum>=10, protein_coding): {len(filtered)} genes', file=sys.stderr)

if len(filtered) < 3:
    print('ERROR: Too few genes for correlation', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

lengths = [f[3] for f in filtered]
means = [f[1] for f in filtered]

n = len(lengths)
mean_len = sum(lengths) / n
mean_expr_all = sum(means) / n

cov = sum((lengths[i] - mean_len) * (means[i] - mean_expr_all) for i in range(n))
std_len = math.sqrt(sum((l - mean_len)**2 for l in lengths))
std_expr = math.sqrt(sum((m - mean_expr_all)**2 for m in means))

if std_len == 0 or std_expr == 0:
    pearson_r = 0.0
else:
    pearson_r = cov / (std_len * std_expr)

print(f'Pearson r = {pearson_r:.10f}', file=sys.stderr)

with open('correlation_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'{pearson_r:.10f}\n')

with open('gene_data.tsv', 'w') as f:
    f.write('gene\tmean_expression\ttotal_counts\tlength\tbiotype\n')
    for gene_name, mean_expr, total, length, biotype in filtered:
        f.write(f'{gene_name}\t{mean_expr:.6f}\t{total:.6f}\t{length:.0f}\t{biotype}\n')

print('Done.', file=sys.stderr)

import os, requests

api_key = open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE','/claude_home/.galaxy/api_key')).read().strip()

os.makedirs('/workspace/data', exist_ok=True)

for ds in datasets:

    url = f'{base}/api/datasets/{ds_id}/display?to_ext={ds.get(\"ext\",\"csv\")}'

        f.write(r2.content)
    print(f'  Saved {len(r2.content)} bytes to {outpath}')
"

# Count columns in expression matrix (samples)
with open('BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip()
    cols = header.split(',')
    print(f'Total columns in expression matrix: {len(cols)}')
    # Show CD14 columns
    cd14_cols = [c for c in cols if 'CD14' in c]
    print(f'CD14 columns ({len(cd14_cols)}): {cd14_cols[:5]}...')

# Count CD14 samples from annotation
import csv
with open('Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    cd14_samples = [row['sample'] for row in reader if row['celltype'] == 'CD14']
    print(f'\\nCD14 samples from annotation: {len(cd14_samples)}')
    print(f'Samples: {sorted(cd14_samples)[:10]}...')

# Check gene biotypes
with open('GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    biotypes = set()
    protein_coding = 0
    for row in reader:
        biotypes.add(row['gene_biotype'])
        if row['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding':
            protein_coding += 1
    print(f'\\nGene biotypes: {sorted(biotypes)}')
    print(f'Protein coding genes: {protein_coding}')
"

# Get CD14 sample names from annotations
import csv
with open('Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    cd14_samples = set(row['sample'] for row in reader if row['celltype'] == 'CD14')

# Get header from expression matrix and find CD14 column indices
with open('BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split(',')
    
# Column 1 is empty/gene ID - columns 2..724 are samples (1-indexed)
cd14_indices = []
not_found = []
for i, col_name in enumerate(header):
    if col_name in cd14_samples:
        cd14_indices.append(i + 1)  # 1-indexed for Cut tool
    elif col_name and col_name != '':
        # not CD14
        pass

print(f'CD14 samples from annotation: {len(cd14_samples)}')
print(f'CD14 columns found in expression matrix: {len(cd14_indices)}')
print(f'First 10 CD14 column indices: {cd14_indices[:10]}')
print(f'Last 5 CD14 column indices: {cd14_indices[-5:]}')

# Save for Galaxy use (comma-separated for Cut tool: c1,c4,c7,...)
# But include column 1 (gene ID) as well
# For Cut: columnList = 'c1,c4,c7,c10,...'
all_indices = [1] + cd14_indices  # include gene ID column
# For Filter Tabular 'select columns': '1,4,7,10,...'
filter_tabular_cols = ','.join(str(i) for i in all_indices)
print(f'\\nTotal columns to keep: {len(all_indices)}')
print(f'Filter Tabular column list (first 200 chars): {filter_tabular_cols[:200]}...')

# Save for later use
with open('/workspace/cd14_column_indices.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(filter_tabular_cols)
print('Saved to /workspace/cd14_column_indices.txt')
"

import bioblend.galaxy
import os

api_key = open("/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key").read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

# Copy the seed history
seed_history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b52b1ceba45fb41a93"
new_history = gi.histories.create_history(name="Working: Pearson corr gene length vs expression CD14")

# Copy datasets from seed history to new history
# First, list contents
contents = gi.histories.show_history(seed_history_id, contents=True)
print("Seed history contents:")
for item in contents:
    print(f"  ID: {item['id']}, Name: {item.get('name', '?')}, Extension: {item.get('extension', '?')}, State: {item.get('state', '?')}")

# Copy each dataset
for item in contents:
    if item.get('history_content_type') == 'dataset':
        gi.histories.copy_content(new_history['id'], item['id'], source='hda')
        print(f"Copied {item['id']} ({item.get('name')}) to new history")

new_contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_history['id'], contents=True)
print("\nNew history ID:", new_history['id'])
print("New history contents:")
for item in new_contents:
    print(f"  ID: {item['id']}, Name: {item.get('name', '?')}, State: {item.get('state', '?')}")

# Save new history ID
with open("/workspace/working_history_id.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(new_history['id'])
PYEOF

# Read CD14 sample names and match them against the expression matrix header
import csv

# Read sample annotations and find CD14 samples
cd14_samples = set()
with open("/workspace/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row['celltype'] == 'CD14':
            cd14_samples.add(row['sample'])

print(f"Number of CD14 samples: {len(cd14_samples)}")
print(f"CD14 samples: {sorted(cd14_samples)[:10]}...")

# Read expression matrix header
with open("/workspace/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv") as f:
    header = f.readline().strip()
    # First field is empty (gene name column)
    columns = header.split(',')
    print(f"\nTotal columns in expression matrix: {len(columns)}")
    print(f"First column: '{columns[0]}'")
    
    cd14_cols = []
    for i, col in enumerate(columns):
        if col in cd14_samples:
            cd14_cols.append((i+1, col))  # 1-indexed for Cut tool
    
    print(f"\nFound {len(cd14_cols)} CD14 columns in expression matrix")
    for idx, name in cd14_cols[:5]:
        print(f"  Column {idx}: {name}")

    # Build Cut string: c1 for gene + all CD14 columns
    # Cut expects "c1,c2,c3,..."
    cut_parts = ['c1'] + [f'c{idx}' for idx, name in cd14_cols]
    cut_string = ','.join(cut_parts)
    print(f"\nCut string length: {len(cut_string)}")
    print(f"Cut string (first 500 chars): {cut_string[:500]}")

# Also check gene metadata for protein_coding
with open("/workspace/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    biotypes = set()
    protein_coding = 0
    for row in reader:
        biotypes.add(row['gene_biotype'])
        if row['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding':
            protein_coding += 1

print(f"\nGene biotypes: {sorted(biotypes)}")
print(f"Protein-coding genes: {protein_coding}")
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy
import csv

api_key = open("/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key").read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

# Download the joined table
gi.datasets.download_dataset("f9cad7b01a4721354bc9891bb817d762", file_path="/workspace/joined_full.tsv", use_default_filename=False, maxwait=120)

# Filter locally: sum >= 10, then prepare two correlation input files
with open("/workspace/joined_full.tsv") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t')
    header = next(reader)
    print(f"Header: {header}")
    print(f"Columns: gene={header[0]}, sum={header[1]}, mean={header[2]}, geneid={header[3]}, length={header[4]}")
    
    filtered_rows = []
    total = 0
    for row in reader:
        total += 1
        try:
            total_count = float(row[1])
            if total_count >= 10:
                filtered_rows.append(row)
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            pass
    
    print(f"Total protein-coding genes: {total}")
    print(f"With total counts >= 10: {len(filtered_rows)}")
    
    # Write length file: gene, length
    with open("/workspace/corr_length.tsv", "w") as fl:
        fl.write("Gene\tLength\n")
        for row in filtered_rows:
            fl.write(f"{row[0]}\t{row[4]}\n")
    
    # Write mean file: gene, mean_expr
    with open("/workspace/corr_mean.tsv", "w") as fm:
        fm.write("Gene\tMeanExpr\n")
        for row in filtered_rows:
            fm.write(f"{row[0]}\t{row[2]}\n")
    
    print(f"Correlation input files written")
    print(f"Sample length rows:")
    with open("/workspace/corr_length.tsv") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if i <= 3:
                print(f"  {line.rstrip()}")
    
    print(f"Sample mean rows:")
    with open("/workspace/corr_mean.tsv") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if i <= 3:
                print(f"  {line.rstrip()}")

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# 1. Load sample annotations to get CD14 samples
samples_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv')
cd14_samples = samples_df[samples_df['celltype'] == 'CD14']['sample'].tolist()
print(f"Number of CD14 samples: {len(cd14_samples)}")

# 2. Load gene metadata - file has leading comma (empty column 0)
gene_meta = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv')
# Columns: Unnamed: 0, Geneid, Chr, Length, gene_biotype
# Actually pandas reads the first empty column as Unnamed: 0
print(f"Gene metadata columns: {gene_meta.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Gene metadata shape: {gene_meta.shape}")

# Filter for protein-coding
pc_genes_meta = gene_meta[gene_meta['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding'].copy()
print(f"Protein-coding genes: {len(pc_genes_meta)}")

# 3. Load expression data
expr = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', index_col=0)
# First column becomes index (gene names)
print(f"Expression data shape: {expr.shape}")
print(f"Expression columns (first 5): {expr.columns[:5].tolist()}")

# Find CD14 columns that exist in expression data
cd14_cols = [c for c in cd14_samples if c in expr.columns]
print(f"CD14 columns found in expression data: {len(cd14_cols)}")
if len(cd14_cols) < len(cd14_samples):
    missing = set(cd14_samples) - set(cd14_cols)
    print(f"Missing CD14 columns: {missing}")

# Subset to CD14 samples
expr_cd14 = expr[cd14_cols]

# 4. Merge: keep only protein-coding genes that are in the expression data
# gene_meta uses 'Geneid' as the gene identifier
# expression data index is the gene name
pc_genes_meta = pc_genes_meta.set_index('Geneid')
common_genes = expr_cd14.index.intersection(pc_genes_meta.index)
print(f"Common protein-coding genes in expression data: {len(common_genes)}")

expr_cd14_pc = expr_cd14.loc[common_genes]
lengths = pc_genes_meta.loc[common_genes, 'Length']

# 5. Filter for expressed genes: total counts across CD14 samples >= 10
total_counts = expr_cd14_pc.sum(axis=1)
expressed_mask = total_counts >= 10
print(f"Expressed protein-coding genes (total counts >= 10): {expressed_mask.sum()}")

expr_expressed = expr_cd14_pc[expressed_mask]
lengths_expressed = lengths[expressed_mask]

# 6. Compute mean expression across CD14 samples
mean_expr = expr_expressed.mean(axis=1)

# 7. Pearson correlation
# First check for zero variance
print(f"Mean expression variance: {mean_expr.var()}")
print(f"Length variance: {lengths_expressed.var()}")
print(f"Mean expression range: [{mean_expr.min()}, {mean_expr.max()}]")
print(f"Length range: [{lengths_expressed.min()}, {lengths_expressed.max()}]")

# Check if log transformation is more appropriate (common in gene expression analysis)
# The question asks for correlation between gene length and mean expression - we use the raw values
pearson_r, pearson_p = stats.pearsonr(lengths_expressed, mean_expr)
print(f"\nPearson r (raw): {pearson_r}")
print(f"Pearson p-value: {pearson_p}")

# Also check log-transformed
log_mean_expr = np.log10(mean_expr + 1)
pearson_r_log, pearson_p_log = stats.pearsonr(lengths_expressed, log_mean_expr)
print(f"Pearson r (log10(mean+1)): {pearson_r_log}")
print(f"Pearson p-value (log): {pearson_p_log}")

# Also try log10(mean_expr + 0.5) or just checking with different transforms
pearson_r_log1p, pearson_p_log1p = stats.pearsonr(lengths_expressed, np.log1p(mean_expr))
print(f"Pearson r (log1p): {pearson_r_log1p}")

import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(pearson_r))
print(f"\nAnswer written: {pearson_r}")
PYEOF

import csv
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# 1. Get CD14 sample names
cd14_samples = set()
with open('/workspace/inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row['celltype'] == 'CD14':
            cd14_samples.add(row['sample'])

print(f"CD14 samples from annotations: {len(cd14_samples)}")

# 2. Get protein-coding gene IDs and lengths
gene_info = {}  # gene_id -> length
with open('/workspace/inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding':
            gene_info[row['Geneid']] = int(row['Length'])

print(f"Protein-coding genes in metadata: {len(gene_info)}")

# 3. Read expression data - find which CD14 columns exist
with open('/workspace/inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)

    # First column is gene name (empty header)
    # Find indices of CD14 columns
    cd14_col_indices = []
    cd14_col_names = []
    for i, col in enumerate(header):
        if i == 0:
            continue  # gene name column
        if col in cd14_samples:
            cd14_col_indices.append(i)
            cd14_col_names.append(col)

    print(f"CD14 columns in expression matrix: {len(cd14_col_indices)}")

    # Now read data for protein-coding genes only
    gene_lengths = []
    mean_expressions = []

    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row[0]
        if gene_id not in gene_info:
            continue

        # Get expression values for CD14 samples
        expr_vals = [float(row[i]) for i in cd14_col_indices]
        total_counts = sum(expr_vals)

        # Filter: total counts >= 10
        if total_counts < 10:
            continue

        gene_lengths.append(gene_info[gene_id])
        mean_expressions.append(np.mean(expr_vals))

print(f"Expressed protein-coding genes (total >= 10): {len(gene_lengths)}")

# 4. Compute Pearson correlation
r, p = stats.pearsonr(gene_lengths, mean_expressions)

print(f"Pearson r = {r}")
print(f"p-value = {p}")

# 5. Also compute Spearman for robustness
rho, p_spearman = stats.spearmanr(gene_lengths, mean_expressions)
print(f"Spearman rho = {rho}")
print(f"Spearman p-value = {p_spearman}")

# Write answer
import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{r}\n")

print(f"Answer written: {r}")

# Recompute with more diagnostics
cd14_samples = set()
with open('/workspace/inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row['celltype'] == 'CD14':
            cd14_samples.add(row['sample'])

gene_info = {}
with open('/workspace/inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding':
            gene_info[row['Geneid']] = int(row['Length'])

with open('/workspace/inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    cd14_col_indices = [i for i, col in enumerate(header) if i > 0 and col in cd14_samples]
    
    gene_lengths = []
    mean_expressions = []
    
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row[0]
        if gene_id not in gene_info:
            continue
        expr_vals = [float(row[i]) for i in cd14_col_indices]
        total = sum(expr_vals)
        if total < 10:
            continue
        gene_lengths.append(gene_info[gene_id])
        mean_expressions.append(np.mean(expr_vals))

gene_lengths = np.array(gene_lengths)
mean_expressions = np.array(mean_expressions)

print(f'N genes: {len(gene_lengths)}')
print(f'Length stats: min={gene_lengths.min()}, max={gene_lengths.max()}, median={np.median(gene_lengths)}')
print(f'Mean expr stats: min={mean_expressions.min():.4f}, max={mean_expressions.max():.4f}, median={np.median(mean_expressions):.4f}')
print(f'Genes with mean expr == 0: {(mean_expressions == 0).sum()}')

# Pearson on raw
r_raw, p_raw = stats.pearsonr(gene_lengths, mean_expressions)
print(f'Pearson r (raw): {r_raw}')

# With log transforms
log_len = np.log10(gene_lengths)
log_expr = np.log10(mean_expressions + 1)
r_log, p_log = stats.pearsonr(log_len, log_expr)
print(f'Pearson r (log10): {r_log}')

# Spearman
rho, p = stats.spearmanr(gene_lengths, mean_expressions)
print(f'Spearman rho: {rho}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
import sys

# 1. Load sample annotations and identify CD14 samples
print("Loading sample annotations...", flush=True)
samples = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv')
cd14_samples = samples[samples['celltype'] == 'CD14']['sample'].tolist()
print(f"  Found {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples", flush=True)

# 2. Load gene metadata, filter to protein_coding
print("Loading gene metadata...", flush=True)
gene_meta = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv')
# Columns: Unnamed: 0, Geneid, Chr, Length, gene_biotype
# First unnamed column seems to be the gene name (matching the first col in expression matrix)
gene_meta.columns = ['gene_name', 'Geneid', 'Chr', 'Length', 'gene_biotype']
print(f"  Gene meta columns: {gene_meta.columns.tolist()}", flush=True)
print(f"  Total genes in meta: {len(gene_meta)}", flush=True)

pc_genes = gene_meta[gene_meta['gene_biotype'] == 'protein_coding'].copy()
print(f"  Protein-coding genes: {len(pc_genes)}", flush=True)

# 3. Load expression matrix
print("Loading expression matrix...", flush=True)
# The first column is unnamed (gene name) matching gene_meta['gene_name']
expr = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv')
print(f"  Expression matrix shape: {expr.shape}", flush=True)
print(f"  First column name: '{expr.columns[0]}'", flush=True)

# Rename first column for clarity
expr = expr.rename(columns={expr.columns[0]: 'gene_name'})

# 4. Verify CD14 sample names exist in expression matrix
expr_cols = set(expr.columns)
missing_cd14 = [s for s in cd14_samples if s not in expr_cols]
if missing_cd14:
    print(f"  WARNING: {len(missing_cd14)} CD14 samples not found in expression matrix", flush=True)
    print(f"  First few missing: {missing_cd14[:5]}", flush=True)
    cd14_samples = [s for s in cd14_samples if s in expr_cols]
    print(f"  Using {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples found in expression matrix", flush=True)
else:
    print(f"  All {len(cd14_samples)} CD14 samples found in expression matrix", flush=True)

# 5. Subset expression to CD14 samples and protein-coding genes
expr_cd14 = expr[['gene_name'] + cd14_samples].copy()
print(f"  CD14 expression submatrix shape: {expr_cd14.shape}", flush=True)

# Merge with protein-coding gene info
merged = pd.merge(pc_genes[['gene_name', 'Length']], expr_cd14, on='gene_name', how='inner')
print(f"  Merged protein-coding genes with expression: {len(merged)}", flush=True)

# 6. Compute total counts across CD14 samples
merged['total_counts'] = merged[cd14_samples].sum(axis=1)
print(f"  Genes with total_counts >= 0: {(merged['total_counts'] >= 0).sum()}", flush=True)
print(f"  Genes with total_counts > 0: {(merged['total_counts'] > 0).sum()}", flush=True)
print(f"  Genes with total_counts >= 10: {(merged['total_counts'] >= 10).sum()}", flush=True)

# Filter to expressed genes (total counts >= 10)
expressed = merged[merged['total_counts'] >= 10].copy()
print(f"  Expressed protein-coding genes: {len(expressed)}", flush=True)

# 7. Compute mean expression across CD14 samples
expressed['mean_expression'] = expressed[cd14_samples].mean(axis=1)

# 8. Check for zeros in length
print(f"  Genes with Length == 0: {(expressed['Length'] == 0).sum()}", flush=True)
print(f"  Genes with Length > 0: {(expressed['Length'] > 0).sum()}", flush=True)
print(f"  Length stats: min={expressed['Length'].min()}, max={expressed['Length'].max()}, mean={expressed['Length'].mean():.1f}", flush=True)
print(f"  Mean expression stats: min={expressed['mean_expression'].min():.4f}, max={expressed['mean_expression'].max():.4f}, mean={expressed['mean_expression'].mean():.4f}", flush=True)

# 9. Compute Pearson correlation
r, p = pearsonr(expressed['Length'], expressed['mean_expression'])
print(f"\n  Pearson r = {r}", flush=True)
print(f"  p-value = {p}", flush=True)
print(f"  n = {len(expressed)}", flush=True)

# Write answer
import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{r}\n")
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {r}", flush=True)
PYEOF
